content.short: Matrica provides NFT-based verification, token-gating, and voting services for Discord servers and includes an NFT wallet.
content.description: Matrica provides features for both users and communities. Users gain auto-verification across more than 1,500 Discord servers, can connect multiple hardware and software wallets, and identify staked or listed NFTs while voting on on-chain proposals with NFTs. For communities and NFT creators, Matrica surfaces their entire collection, shows current marketplace listings and NFT statuses, and streamlines Discord workflows with hierarchical roles, bot notifications, and other workflow enhancements.
content.meta: Matrica provides NFT tooling for users and communities: verification, token-gating, and voting. Discover Matrica and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
